description.summary: a cursor and keyboard focus of an agent's own

protocol.description:
An agent that shares the user's pointer takes it away from them. This protocol gives each agent its own seat: a pointer drawn as a coloured cursor carrying the agent's name, and a keyboard focus of its own, so the user keeps working while agents work, and several agents work at once.
An agent cursor takes the same events as a crownos_input_injector_v1 and delivers them through its own wl_seat. Its focus is confined to the agent workspace: it may only enter windows there, so an agent never acts in the user's windows unless the user hands one over by moving it there. Agent input never triggers compositor shortcuts and never unlocks the session.
Only the agent daemon can bind the manager global.
Warning! The protocol described in this file is currently in the testing phase. Backward compatible changes may be added together with the corresponding interface version bump. Backward incompatible changes can only be done by creating a new major version of the extension.

entry.name: invalid_name
entry.summary: the name is empty, longer than 32 bytes or contains a control character

entry.name: too_many
entry.summary: the compositor's limit on agent cursors is reached

request.name: destroy
request.description: Cursors created through it live on until destroyed individually.

request.name: create_cursor
request.description: Creates a cursor and the seat behind it. name is shown on the cursor's flag and in every prompt about this agent; color is 0xRRGGBB. The compositor answers with created once the seat's wl_seat global is announced, or revoked.

interface.name: crownos_agent_cursor_v1

description.summary: one agent's cursor, pointer and keyboard

interface.description:
Events are grouped into frames as on crownos_input_injector_v1: every input request adds to the pending frame and frame applies them in order. Coordinates are in the agent workspace's logical space, (0, 0) at its top-left.
Keys and buttons still pressed when the cursor is destroyed or revoked are released by the compositor.

entry.name: invalid_value
entry.summary: an enum argument is out of range

entry.name: refused
entry.summary: the compositor would not create the seat

description.summary: destroy the cursor and its seat

request.name: pointer_motion_absolute
request.description: Moves the pointer to (x, y) in the agent workspace's logical space.

request.name: frame
request.description: Applies the pending events in order as one logical hardware event stamped with time_ms, a CLOCK_MONOTONIC millisecond timestamp, or 0 for now.

request.name: focus_window

description.summary: give the agent's keyboard focus to a window

request.description: Focuses the window with this ext_foreign_toplevel identifier on the agent's seat. A window outside the agent workspace is ignored.

event.name: created
event.description: The name of the wl_seat behind this cursor, so the client can tell the agent's input apart in its own windows.

event.name: focus_changed
event.description: The ext_foreign_toplevel identifier of the focused window, or empty.

event.name: revoked
event.description: The seat is gone and further requests are ignored. The client should destroy the object.
